description: Set the active shopping country/region using any natural country name, city (e.g. 'Dubai', 'London', 'California', 'Paris'), 2-letter ISO code ('US', 'GB', 'IN', 'AE', 'CA'), or currency ('USD', 'AED', 'GBP', 'EUR'). Saves to persistent local JSON (~/.polopan/region.json) so the user never needs to be asked again across turns and sessions.

country.description: Target country name, alias, city, currency, or ISO-2 code (e.g. 'United States', 'US', 'UK', 'London', 'Dubai', 'UAE', 'Canada', 'India', 'Germany', 'AED', 'EUR')

mode.description: Catalog mode: 'global' (ships to country) or 'local' (domestic store only). Defaults to 'global'.

name: region.set_current
title: Set Current Shopping Region
